scope: T2 k3s golden: an overlay of the nested-Incus golden, dedicated and disposable; k3s, its registry and helm run only inside twins booted from it; no shared Incus/Kubernetes/tunnel/deploy state
recipe:
incus launch parity-noble k1 -c security.privileged=true -c security.nesting=true -c boot.autostart=true -c linux.kernel_modules=overlay,br_netfilter,ip_tables,ip6_tables,nf_nat,xt_conntrack,iptable_nat,iptable_filter -c raw.lxc='lxc.apparmor.profile=unconfined
lxc.cap.drop=
lxc.cgroup2.devices.allow=a
lxc.mount.auto=proc:rw sys:rw cgroup:rw'
incus config device add k1 kmsg unix-char source=/dev/kmsg path=/dev/kmsg
incus exec k1 -- timeout 300 sh -c 'until systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null | grep -qE "running|degraded"; do sleep 1; done'
incus exec k1 -- sh -c 'apt-get update -q && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -q curl'

curl -fsSL -o /tmp/k3s https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/releases/download/v1.31.2%2Bk3s1/k3s && echo '256ca852ff2ca165afbc14ed34df450aa1295e4eb01e3d1da9f251f37e546712  /tmp/k3s' | sha256sum -c - && incus file push --mode 0755 /tmp/k3s k1/usr/local/bin/k3s && rm /tmp/k3s

curl -fsSL -o /tmp/images.tar.zst https://github.com/k3s-io/k3s/releases/download/v1.31.2%2Bk3s1/k3s-airgap-images-amd64.tar.zst && echo 'c1f62ca3b15699d3bc5b4c84d6e458d8f5b9ff8572299bebdf0a0295edeed135  /tmp/images.tar.zst' | sha256sum -c - && incus exec k1 -- mkdir -p /var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/images && incus file push /tmp/images.tar.zst k1/var/lib/rancher/k3s/agent/images/k3s-airgap-images-amd64.tar.zst && rm /tmp/images.tar.zst

printf '%s' '[Unit]
Description=k3s server (parity T2)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=notify
ExecStartPre=-/sbin/modprobe br_netfilter
ExecStartPre=-/sbin/modprobe overlay
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/k3s server --node-name=k1 --write-kubeconfig-mode=0644 --disable=traefik,servicelb,metrics-server --disable-helm-controller
KillMode=process
Delegate=yes
LimitNOFILE=1048576
LimitNPROC=infinity
LimitCORE=infinity
TasksMax=infinity
TimeoutStartSec=0
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
' > /tmp/k3s.service && incus file push /tmp/k3s.service k1/etc/systemd/system/k3s.service && rm /tmp/k3s.service
incus exec k1 -- sh -c 'systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl enable --now k3s.service'

incus exec k1 -- timeout 600 sh -c 'until k3s kubectl get --raw=/readyz >/dev/null 2>&1 && k3s kubectl get node k1 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done' && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready node/k1 --timeout=600s && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n kube-system rollout status deploy/coredns --timeout=600s && incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n kube-system rollout status deploy/local-path-provisioner --timeout=600s
incus exec k1 -- k3s ctr images pull docker.io/library/registry:2.8.3

printf '%s' 'apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: registry
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: opute-registry
  namespace: registry
spec:
  accessModes: [ReadWriteOnce]
  storageClassName: local-path
  resources:
    requests: {storage: 1Gi}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: opute-registry-config
  namespace: registry
data:
  config.yml: |
    version: 0.1
    storage:
      filesystem: {rootdirectory: /var/lib/registry}
      delete: {enabled: true}
    http: {addr: ":5000"}
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: opute-registry
  namespace: registry
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy: {type: Recreate}
  selector:
    matchLabels: {app: opute-registry}
  template:
    metadata:
      labels: {app: opute-registry}
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: registry
          image: docker.io/library/registry:2.8.3
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          command: ["registry", "serve", "/etc/distribution/config.yml"]
          ports: [{containerPort: 5000}]
          volumeMounts:
            - {name: data, mountPath: /var/lib/registry}
            - {name: config, mountPath: /etc/distribution}
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim: {claimName: opute-registry}
        - name: config
          configMap: {name: opute-registry-config}
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: opute-registry
  namespace: registry
spec:
  selector: {app: opute-registry}
  ports: [{port: 5000, targetPort: 5000}]
' | incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl apply -f -
incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n registry rollout status deploy/opute-registry --timeout=600s

REG=$(incus exec k1 -- k3s kubectl -n registry get svc opute-registry -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}') && for pair in mirrored-pause:3.6=parity/app:v1 mirrored-library-busybox:1.36.1=parity/app:v2; do src=docker.io/rancher/${pair%%=*}; dst=$REG:5000/${pair#*=}; incus exec k1 -- k3s ctr images tag "$src" "$dst" && incus exec k1 -- k3s ctr images push --plain-http "$dst" && incus exec k1 -- k3s ctr images rm "$dst" || exit 1; done

curl -fsSL -o /tmp/helm.tgz https://get.helm.sh/helm-v3.16.2-linux-amd64.tar.gz && echo '9318379b847e333460d33d291d4c088156299a26cd93d570a7f5d0c36e50b5bb  /tmp/helm.tgz' | sha256sum -c - && tar -xzf /tmp/helm.tgz -C /tmp linux-amd64/helm && install -m 0755 /tmp/linux-amd64/helm /usr/local/bin/helm && rm -rf /tmp/helm.tgz /tmp/linux-amd64
